trans-unit.source: Can't you do something about all those annoying “click click” noises!?
trans-unit.target: Can't you do something about all those annoying “click click” noises!?

trans-unit.source: For what? These clappers are essential for summoning artes!
trans-unit.target: For what? These clappers are essential for summoning artes!

trans-unit.source: You mean you can't do your thing without them?
trans-unit.target: You mean you can't do your thing without them?

trans-unit.source: What a pain being human. If only you could use real magic.
trans-unit.target: What a pain being human. If only you could use real magic.

trans-unit.source: An undisciplined half-elf like you can't appreciate the dedication my arte requires!
trans-unit.target: An undisciplined half-elf like you can't appreciate the dedication my arte requires!
